caseno: Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 587 of 2005
lawyer:
S.N. Goswami, Advocate, instructed by Syed Mahbubur Rahman, Advocate-on-record ------ For the Petitioners 
Md. Nawab Ali, Advocate-on-record ------ For the Respondents
parties:
Mongol Sarder being dead his heirs: Adbur Razzaque Sarder and others ------ Petitioners
Vs.
Md. Azahar Ali Pk. Being dead his heirs Mst. Tulujannessa and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 5. The contesting defendants went on appeal. The appellate Court allowed the appeal on the finding that Abdul Majid, plaintiff No. 28 from whom plaintiffs purchased the land in suit deposed as P.W.11 and has stated that he had neither read the plaint nor he signed the plaint, that Abdul Majid is claiming .70 acre of land, that from the evidence of P.W.11 it is seen that at the time of pattan he was a boy of 6 years "and as such it is hard to believe that he took pattan of the suit land" and that he (P.W.11) admitted "he did not, pay any money on the day of pattan", that in the amalnama Ext.2 "the names of the landlords have not been printed", that there is no evidence that Jugal Kisore Mazumder, the manager was the head employee of the Zamindar and that he had the authority to sign the papers of pattan and that no document had been produced to show that Jugal Kisore Mazumdar was an employee of the landlord, that scribe of the Ext. 3 series (Dakhilas) has not been examined, that plaintiffs failed to prove their possession in the land in suit, that no deed of delivery of possession was filed to establish the case that after auction purchase possession of the auction purchase land was taken by the auction purchaser or in other words purchase land was taken by the auction purchaser or in other words possession was delivered to the auction purchaser, that there is no evidence on record that Jugal Kisore Mozumdar ever collected any rent from Sabjan Nessa Bibi in respect of the land in suit as landlord. Finally the appellate Court held "Since the suit jote was correctly recorded in the name of Sabjan Nessa Bibi, the pre predecessor of defendant Nos. 1 and 2, in the C.S. Khatian and since the suit jote has been recorded in favour of defendant Nos. 1 and 2 in the R.S. khatian and since there is no cogent evidence on record that the interest of Sabjan Nessa Bibi, the predecessor of the defendant Nos. 1 and 2, in the suit jote was legally extinguished and since the alleged pattan in favour of Abdul Mazid and the possession of Plaintiffs in the suit have not been proved to the hilt and since the suit is bad for defect of parties, hold that the learned Subordinate Judge was not justified in decreeing the suit" and thereupon allowed the appeal.
